name: GGUF TQ1_0 / TQ2_0 (ternarized quants, QK_K super-block, trit-packed)
bits: TQ1_0 1.6875 bpw, TQ2_0 2.0625 bpw (both from the struct comments in ggml-common.h). Quantize tool strings: TQ1_0 '1.69 bpw ternarization', TQ2_0 '2.06 bpw ternarization'
quality_delta: Official quantizer strings only (qlab2-quantize-options-table): TQ1_0 '1.69 bpw ternarization', TQ2_0 '2.06 bpw ternarization'. No controlled fp16 perplexity delta published in any primary source found. Null + note.
notes: Weight-only: activations are promoted to q8_K for the dot product and the matmul runs at fp16/bf16, so native_support is deliberately EMPTY and the whole accelerator ecosystem is emulated_support. No accelerator has a GGUF quant path in silicon - this is the single most commonly botched field in this repo. TQ = TERNARIZED QUANT, structurally verified from ggml-common.h: block_tq1_0 = { uint8_t qs[(QK_K - 4*QK_K/64)/5];  // the comment is '5 elements per byte (3^5 = 243 < 256)' - trits base-3 packed 5 to a byte uint8_t qh[QK_K/64];        // '4 elements per byte', and the struct comment says 'high bits' ggml_half d; } with the size assert sizeof(half) + QK_K/64 + (QK_K - 4*QK_K/64)/5. So 3^5 = 243 <= 256 is the packing constraint - the reason you cannot simply pack 5.33 trits per byte. block_tq2_0 is the near-true-2-bit sibling: { uint8_t qs[QK_K/4] (2 bits per element); ggml_half d; } = 66 bytes / 256 = 2.0625 bpw, identical in size to iq2_xxs. Both use the FULL 256-value super-block, which is what lets them beat the 32-value legacy ternary schemes at equal bpw. Weight type ids are 34 (TQ1_0) and 35 (TQ2_0), i.e. they were added late to the ggml enum, after the i-quants. Note TQ quants are a SEPARATE lineage from the ternary/bitnet-b158 records already in this repo: those are training-time ternary weights, these are post-training ternarization of an fp16/bf16 checkpoint inside the GGUF pipeline. SCHEME RECLASSIFIED (parent agent, 2026-10-03): scheme was 'ternary' (a proxy recorded while the enum lacked a legal value) and is now 'gguf-tq1-0'.
